entries.title: A3C
entries.description: Asynchronous actor-critic — parallel agents, no replay buffer. Used in Continuous control, games.

entries.title: AutoEncoder
entries.description: Neural network designed to learn efficient codings of unlabeled data by compressing and reconstructing the input.

entries.title: ALBERT
entries.description: A Lite BERT that shares parameters across layers and uses sentence-order prediction, achieving BERT-level accuracy with far fewer parameters.

entries.title: AlexNet
entries.description: The deep CNN that won the ImageNet 2012 challenge and sparked the deep learning revolution.

entries.title: ALIGN
entries.description: Noisy 1.8B image-text pairs + EfficientNet + BERT — scale over curation. Used in Google noisy contrastive learning.

entries.title: AlphaGo
entries.description: Policy network + value network + MCTS — beat world champion. Used in DeepMind, game AI.

entries.title: AlphaZero
entries.description: Self-play only — no human data — mastered Go, Chess, Shogi. Used in DeepMind tabula rasa RL.

entries.title: Attention Seq2Seq
entries.description: Encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence model with additive (Bahdanau) attention, allowing the decoder to selectively focus on relevant encoder states.

entries.title: Attention U-Net
entries.description: Attention gates focus on relevant regions — improved medical segmentation. Used in Pancreas, prostate CT segmentation.

entries.title: AutoInt
entries.description: Multi-head self-attention for feature interactions — automatic feature crossing. Used in CTR prediction research.

entries.title: BART
entries.description: Denoising autoencoder for sequence-to-sequence pre-training that combines a bidirectional BERT encoder with an autoregressive GPT decoder.

entries.title: BEiT
entries.description: Masked Image Modeling — visual tokenizer + BERT-style pre-training. Used in Self-supervised vision.

entries.title: BERT
entries.description: Bidirectional encoder Transformer pre-trained with masked language modeling, defining the pretrain-then-finetune paradigm for NLP.

entries.title: BERT4Rec
entries.description: Bidirectional transformer for recommendation — Cloze task. Used in Session-based recommendation.

entries.title: Bidirectional RNN
entries.description: RNN variant that processes sequences in both forward and backward directions, giving each timestep access to past and future context.

entries.title: BigGAN
entries.description: Class-conditional GAN at scale — truncation trick, orthogonal regularization. Used in High-fidelity class-conditioned synthesis.

entries.title: BLIP
entries.description: Bootstrapped language-image pre-training — noisy web data + ITC+ITM+LM. Used in Salesforce, multimodal retrieval.

entries.title: BLIP-2
entries.description: Q-Former bridges frozen image encoder and frozen LLM. Used in Efficient vision-language alignment.

entries.title: BLOOM
entries.description: Open multilingual large language model trained on 46 languages and 13 programming languages by the BigScience collaborative.

entries.title: CenterNet
entries.description: Objects as points — center heatmap + size/offset regression. Used in Efficient anchor-free detection.

entries.title: ChebNet
entries.description: Chebyshev polynomial filters — efficient spectral graph convolution. Used in Graph signal processing.

entries.title: Chinchilla
entries.description: DeepMind scaling-laws study showing that optimal LLM training uses far more tokens per parameter than previous models, resulting in a 70B model that outperforms GPT-3.

entries.title: CLIP
entries.description: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining connects text and images by training on a large variety of internet-sourced pairs.

entries.title: CoCa
entries.description: Contrastive + captioning loss in single model — no task-specific fine-tuning needed. Used in Google unified vision-language.

entries.title: Codex
entries.description: GPT-3 fine-tuned on GitHub code that powers GitHub Copilot, capable of translating natural language to working code across many languages.

entries.title: CogVLM
entries.description: Visual expert — dedicated trainable parameters per transformer layer. Used in Deep visual understanding.

entries.title: Conditional GAN
entries.description: Class label conditioning — controlled generation. Used in Conditional image synthesis.

entries.title: Consistency Models
entries.description: Single-step generation via self-consistency — 100× faster inference. Used in Research, fast generation.

entries.title: ControlNet
entries.description: Trainable copy of SD encoder — conditional control (pose, depth, edge). Used in Production image editing.

entries.title: ConvNeXt
entries.description: Pure CNN redesigned using Vision Transformer training recipes and design choices, matching or surpassing Swin Transformers on image benchmarks.

entries.title: ConvNeXt V2
entries.description: FCMAE pre-training + Global Response Normalization — best pure-CNN vs. ViT. Used in CNN-as-ViT alternative.

entries.title: CornerNet
entries.description: Anchor-free: detect corners as heatmaps + associative embedding. Used in Anchor-free detection research.

entries.title: CvT
entries.description: Convolutional token embedding — adds CNN inductive bias to ViT. Used in Efficient vision transformers.

entries.title: CycleGAN
entries.description: Unpaired image-to-image via cycle consistency loss. Used in Style transfer, domain adaptation.

entries.title: DALL-E
entries.description: Transformer over text+image tokens — zero-shot text-to-image. Used in OpenAI image generation.

entries.title: DALL-E 2
entries.description: CLIP image embeddings as prior + unCLIP decoder. Used in OpenAI image generation.

entries.title: DALL-E 3
entries.description: GPT-4 as recaptioner — dramatically improved prompt following. Used in ChatGPT image generation.

entries.title: DARTS
entries.description: Differentiable Architecture Search that relaxes discrete architecture choices to continuous, enabling gradient-based neural architecture search.

entries.title: DCGAN
entries.description: Deep convolutional GAN — architecture guidelines for stable training. Used in Image synthesis baseline.

entries.title: DCN
entries.description: Cross network — explicit feature crossing of arbitrary order. Used in Google production recommendation.

entries.title: DCN v2
entries.description: Mixture of low-rank cross layers — improved expressivity + efficiency. Used in Google Search ads.

entries.title: DDIM
entries.description: Deterministic sampling — 10–50× faster inference via non-Markovian process. Used in All production diffusion pipelines.

entries.title: DDPG
entries.description: Deterministic policy gradient — continuous action spaces. Used in Robotic manipulation.

entries.title: DDPM
entries.description: Denoising diffusion — forward/reverse Markov chain, simple objective. Used in Foundation of all modern diffusion.

entries.title: DeBERTa
entries.description: Decoding-enhanced BERT with disentangled attention, representing position and content with separate vectors to improve NLU benchmarks.

entries.title: Decision Transformer
entries.description: Sequence modeling as RL — returns-conditioned autoregressive policy. Used in Offline RL as language modeling.

entries.title: DeepFM
entries.description: FM replaces wide part — no manual feature engineering. Used in Huawei App Store, CTR prediction.

entries.title: DeepLab v1
entries.description: Atrous (dilated) convolutions — larger receptive field without downsampling. Used in Semantic segmentation.

entries.title: DeepLab v2
entries.description: ASPP (Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling) — multi-scale context. Used in PASCAL VOC SOTA.

entries.title: DeepLab v3
entries.description: Improved ASPP + batch norm — no CRF needed. Used in Semantic segmentation SOTA.

entries.title: DeepLab v3+
entries.description: Encoder-decoder with atrous separable conv — Xception backbone. Used in Cityscapes, ADE20K.

entries.title: DeepLabV3+
entries.description: State-of-the-art semantic segmentation using Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling and an encoder-decoder structure.

entries.title: DeepSeek-V2
entries.description: 236B mixture-of-experts language model using Multi-head Latent Attention and DeepSeekMoE to dramatically reduce KV cache size and training costs.

entries.title: DeepWalk
entries.description: Random walks + Word2Vec on graph — learns node embeddings. Used in Social network analysis.

entries.title: Deformable DETR
entries.description: Deformable attention — attends to sparse key points, 10× faster convergence. Used in COCO detection research.

entries.title: DeiT
entries.description: Distillation token — train ViT without huge JFT data. Used in Efficient ViT training.

entries.title: DenseNet
entries.description: Connects each layer to every other layer in a feed-forward fashion, mitigating the vanishing-gradient problem.

entries.title: DETR
entries.description: End-to-end detection via bipartite matching + transformer — no NMS. Used in Anchor-free detection paradigm shift.

entries.title: DIEN
entries.description: Interest evolution network — GRU with attention over temporal behavior. Used in Alibaba, interest dynamics.

entries.title: DiffPool
entries.description: Differentiable graph pooling — learns hierarchical representations. Used in Graph classification (hierarchical).

entries.title: Diffusion Models
entries.description: Generative models that learn to reverse a gradual noising process.

entries.title: DIN
entries.description: Attention over user behavior history — interest activation by candidate item. Used in Alibaba Taobao, CTR.

entries.title: DINO
entries.description: Self-supervised Vision Transformers that learn features with no labels.

entries.title: DistilBERT
entries.description: Knowledge-distilled version of BERT that retains 97% of language understanding while being 40% smaller and 60% faster.

entries.title: DiT
entries.description: Diffusion Transformer — replaces U-Net backbone with ViT + adaLN-Zero. Used in Sora's architecture basis.

entries.title: DLRM
entries.description: Facebook's production RecSys — embedding tables + MLP + dot product interactions. Used in Meta ads ranking.

entries.title: Double DQN
entries.description: Separate action selection and evaluation — reduces overestimation bias. Used in Standard DQN improvement.

entries.title: DQN
entries.description: Experience replay + target network — stable deep Q-learning. Used in Atari benchmark baseline.

entries.title: Dreamer
entries.description: World model in latent space — imagine trajectories, train actor-critic in imagination. Used in Sample-efficient visual RL.

entries.title: Dueling DQN
entries.description: Separate value + advantage streams — better state value estimation. Used in Atari games.

entries.title: EfficientDet
entries.description: BiFPN + compound scaling — Pareto-optimal detection. Used in Google Cloud Vision.

entries.title: EfficientNet
entries.description: Rethinks CNN scaling by systematically balancing network depth, width, and resolution.

entries.title: EfficientNetV2
entries.description: Faster and smaller EfficientNet variant using Fused-MBConv blocks and progressive learning, achieving 4x faster training than EfficientNetV1.

entries.title: ELECTRA
entries.description: Sample-efficient pre-training where a generator replaces tokens and a discriminator learns to detect replacements, outperforming masked language modeling.

entries.title: ELMo
entries.description: Embeddings from Language Models using deep bidirectional LSTMs, producing contextual word representations that capture syntax and semantics.

entries.title: Falcon
entries.description: Open-source LLM from TII trained on curated web data with multi-query attention and FlashAttention, achieving top open-model performance at release.

entries.title: Fast R-CNN
entries.description: RoI Pooling — end-to-end training, shared conv features. Used in Detection speed improvement.

entries.title: Faster R-CNN
entries.description: Region Proposal Network — region proposals inside the network. Used in Two-stage detection gold standard.

entries.title: FastText
entries.description: Efficient word representation and text classification method that enriches word vectors with subword information via character n-grams.

entries.title: Fully Convolutional Network
entries.description: Pioneering architecture for dense prediction replacing dense layers with convolutions.

entries.title: FCOS
entries.description: Fully convolutional, anchor-free, centerness branch. Used in Single-stage anchor-free detection.

entries.title: Flamingo
entries.description: Perceiver resampler + cross-attention into frozen LLM — few-shot multimodal. Used in DeepMind vision-language.

entries.title: Flux
entries.description: Flow matching + rectified flows + MMDiT — 12B param open diffusion. Used in Open-source, high-quality generation.

entries.title: FPN
entries.description: Feature Pyramid Network — multi-scale feature hierarchy. Used in Detection backbone standard.

entries.title: Generative Adversarial Network
entries.description: Two neural networks contesting with each other in a zero-sum game frame, yielding highly realistic generative models.

entries.title: GAT
entries.description: Attention-based aggregation — weight neighbors by importance. Used in Knowledge graphs, molecular graphs.

entries.title: Gato
entries.description: Single generalist agent — 604 tasks across text, image, action in one model. Used in DeepMind generalist agent research.

entries.title: GATv2
entries.description: Dynamic graph attention — fixed expressivity limitation in GAT. Used in Graph classification.

entries.title: GauGAN / SPADE
entries.description: SPADE normalization — spatially adaptive denormalization from semantic layout. Used in NVIDIA Canvas, semantic image synthesis.

entries.title: GCN
entries.description: Spectral simplified 1st-order — message passing on graph neighborhoods. Used in Node classification, citation networks.

entries.title: Gemini
entries.description: Natively multimodal from pre-training — text+image+audio+video. Used in Google products.

entries.title: Gemini 1.0
entries.description: Natively multimodal — trained jointly on text, image, audio, video. Used in Google products, API.

entries.title: Gemini 1.5
entries.description: 1M token context via MQA + ring attention. Used in Google AI Studio.

entries.title: GIN
entries.description: Graph Isomorphism Network — theoretically as powerful as Weisfeiler-Leman test. Used in Graph classification benchmark.

entries.title: GloVe
entries.description: Global Vectors for Word Representation — trains word embeddings from global word-word co-occurrence statistics, capturing linear word analogies.

entries.title: GoogLeNet
entries.description: Introduced the Inception module to compute multiple filter sizes in parallel, significantly reducing parameters.

entries.title: GoogLeNet / Inception v1
entries.description: Inception module: parallel 1×1, 3×3, 5×5, pooling branches. Used in Mobile-class networks.

entries.title: Gopher
entries.description: DeepMind 280B parameter transformer language model with RSNorm and relative positional encodings, extensively analyzed for factual knowledge.

entries.title: GPT
entries.description: Decoder-only Transformer trained on next-token prediction — the architecture behind GPT-3, ChatGPT, and modern generative AI.

entries.title: GPT-1
entries.description: First Generative Pre-trained Transformer demonstrating that unsupervised language model pretraining followed by task-specific fine-tuning achieves strong NLP performance.

entries.title: GPT-2
entries.description: 1.5B parameter language model demonstrating zero-shot task transfer and surprisingly coherent long-form text generation from prompts alone.

entries.title: GPT-3
entries.description: 175B parameter autoregressive language model enabling few-shot learning purely through prompting, without any gradient updates.

entries.title: GPT-4
entries.description: OpenAI multimodal large language model with human-level performance on professional and academic benchmarks, accepting both text and image inputs.

entries.title: GPT-4o
entries.description: Omni model from OpenAI that reasons across text, audio, and vision in real-time with a single end-to-end neural network.

entries.title: GPT-4V
entries.description: Vision inputs natively integrated in GPT-4 — vision reasoning. Used in OpenAI API, enterprise AI.

entries.title: Graph Transformer
entries.description: Full transformer on graphs — Laplacian positional encodings. Used in Graph-level tasks.

entries.title: GraphGPS
entries.description: General, Powerful, Scalable — local MPNN + global attention + positional encoding. Used in Unified graph learning benchmark.

entries.title: Graphormer
entries.description: Centrality + spatial encoding — won OGB graph-level prediction. Used in Molecular property prediction (Microsoft).

entries.title: GraphSAGE
entries.description: Inductive learning via neighborhood sampling + aggregation — scales to new nodes. Used in Pinterest PinSage, large graphs.

entries.title: GRU
entries.description: Gated Recurrent Unit is a streamlined variant of LSTM with fewer parameters and no separate cell state.

entries.title: ImageBind
entries.description: Single embedding space for 6 modalities — audio, video, text, image, depth, IMU. Used in Meta AI, cross-modal retrieval.

entries.title: Imagen
entries.description: Large frozen T5 language model + cascaded diffusion — text fidelity focus. Used in Google image synthesis research.

entries.title: Inception-v2/v3
entries.description: Improvements to GoogLeNet with factorized convolutions and batch normalization, achieving better accuracy with lower computational cost.

entries.title: Inception-v4 / Inception-ResNet
entries.description: Inception architecture combined with residual connections, showing that both can coexist and improve convergence speed and final accuracy.

entries.title: InceptionV3
entries.description: Refined the Inception architecture with factorized convolutions and RMSProp training.

entries.title: InstructBLIP
entries.description: Instruction-tuned Q-Former — state-of-art zero-shot VQA. Used in Salesforce multimodal assistant.

entries.title: InstructGPT
entries.description: GPT-3 aligned with human preferences via RLHF, following instructions more reliably and producing safer, more helpful outputs.

entries.title: LDM
entries.description: Latent space diffusion — 4–8× smaller diffusion space via VQ-VAE perceptual compression. Used in Stable Diffusion core.

entries.title: LeNet
entries.description: One of the earliest convolutional neural networks, primarily used for handwritten digit recognition.

entries.title: LeNet-5
entries.description: Convolutional layers + pooling + FC for digit recognition. Used in OCR, embedded systems.

entries.title: LLaMA
entries.description: A collection of foundational language models designed to be open and efficient.

entries.title: LLaMA 2
entries.description: Meta open-source LLM family (7B-70B) with grouped-query attention and RLHF fine-tuning, released with a permissive commercial license.

entries.title: LLaMA 3
entries.description: Meta open-source LLM family (8B-405B) with expanded 128K vocabulary, grouped-query attention, and improved instruction following.

entries.title: LLaVA
entries.description: Linear projection from CLIP→LLaMA + visual instruction tuning. Used in Open-source multimodal LLM.

entries.title: LLaVA 1.5
entries.description: MLP connector + higher-res + better instruction data — 10× more efficient. Used in Multimodal LLM research standard.

entries.title: LSTM
entries.description: Long Short-Term Memory networks introduced gating mechanisms to solve the vanishing gradient problem in standard RNNs.

entries.title: MAE
entries.description: Masked Autoencoder — 75% masking ratio + lightweight decoder. Used in FAIR self-supervised learning.

entries.title: Mamba
entries.description: Selective state-space sequence model that scales linearly with sequence length, matching transformer quality on language tasks without attention.

entries.title: Mask R-CNN
entries.description: RoIAlign + mask head — instance segmentation. Used in COCO instance seg baseline.

entries.title: Mask2Former
entries.description: Masked attention — single model for semantic/instance/panoptic. Used in COCO panoptic SOTA.

entries.title: Matrix Factorization
entries.description: Latent factor decomposition of user-item matrix. Used in Netflix Prize winner.

entries.title: MaxViT
entries.description: Multi-axis attention: local window + dilated global — best ImageNet without extra data. Used in Vision backbone research.

entries.title: MiniGPT-4
entries.description: Single linear layer aligning visual encoder with Vicuna. Used in Lightweight multimodal LLM.

entries.title: Mistral 7B
entries.description: 7B parameter open LLM using grouped-query attention and sliding window attention, outperforming LLaMA-2-13B on most benchmarks.

entries.title: Mixtral 8x7B
entries.description: Sparse mixture-of-experts model with 8 expert feed-forward networks per layer, routing each token to 2 experts for efficient inference.

entries.title: MobileNetV1
entries.description: Lightweight CNN for mobile and embedded vision applications using depthwise separable convolutions to reduce computation dramatically.

entries.title: MobileNetV2
entries.description: Inverted residual blocks with linear bottlenecks for efficient mobile inference, preserving gradient flow through narrow feature maps.

entries.title: MobileNetV3
entries.description: NAS-optimized mobile architecture combining hard-swish activation, SE modules, and NetAdapt algorithm for hardware-aware efficiency.

entries.title: Mixture of Experts
entries.description: Sparse model architecture where a routing mechanism sends inputs to specific 'experts' within the network.

entries.title: MPNN
entries.description: Message Passing Neural Network — unifying framework for molecular graphs. Used in Quantum chemistry, drug discovery.

entries.title: MuZero
entries.description: Learns world model + value/policy without environment rules. Used in DeepMind, model-based RL.

entries.title: NASNet
entries.description: Neural architecture searched by reinforcement learning on CIFAR-10 and transferred to ImageNet, discovering Normal and Reduction cells automatically.

entries.title: NCF
entries.description: Neural Collaborative Filtering — MLP replaces dot product. Used in Academic RecSys benchmark.

entries.title: Node2Vec
entries.description: Biased random walks (BFS/DFS balance) — flexible neighborhood sampling. Used in Link prediction, node classification.

entries.title: OPT
entries.description: Open Pretrained Transformer language models (125M-175B) from Meta, fully open for research to democratize access to large-scale language modeling.

entries.title: PaLM
entries.description: Pathways Language Model — 540B parameter LLM trained with Google Pathways achieving breakthrough performance on reasoning tasks.

entries.title: PaLM 2
entries.description: Successor to PaLM with improved multilingual, reasoning, and coding capabilities, trained on a more diverse dataset with compute-optimal scaling.

entries.title: Panoptic FPN
entries.description: Unified stuff + things — single panoptic segmentation model. Used in Panoptic segmentation baseline.

entries.title: Phi-2
entries.description: 2.7B parameter small language model from Microsoft that matches or outperforms much larger models by training on high-quality textbook-style data.

entries.title: PinSage
entries.description: Industrial graph neural network for pins — random walk + GNN on billion-node graph. Used in Pinterest, item recommendation.

entries.title: Pix2Pix
entries.description: Paired image-to-image translation — PatchGAN discriminator. Used in Image translation applications.

entries.title: PPO
entries.description: Clipped surrogate objective — simpler TRPO, robust, scalable. Used in OpenAI Gym, InstructGPT, game AI.

entries.title: ProGAN
entries.description: Progressive growing — start small, add layers — stable high-res training. Used in Celebrity face generation.

entries.title: PSPNet
entries.description: Pyramid Pooling Module — global context aggregation. Used in ADE20K winner 2016.

entries.title: PVT
entries.description: Pyramid Vision Transformer — spatial reduction attention for dense prediction. Used in Detection + segmentation backbone.

entries.title: Qwen
entries.description: Alibaba open-source bilingual (Chinese-English) language model family with strong code and math capabilities.

entries.title: R-CNN
entries.description: Region proposals → CNN features → SVM — first deep object detection. Used in Detection research baseline.

entries.title: R-GCN
entries.description: Relational GCN — different weight matrices per edge type. Used in Knowledge graph completion.

entries.title: Rainbow
entries.description: Combines 6 DQN improvements — prioritized replay, n-step, distributional, noisy. Used in Atari benchmark SOTA.

entries.title: RegNet
entries.description: Regular network design space that parameterizes CNN architectures with simple linear constraints, enabling principled network scaling.

entries.title: ResNet
entries.description: Residual networks that made very deep CNNs trainable through skip connections, winning ImageNet 2015.

entries.title: ResNeXt
entries.description: Aggregated residual transformations extending ResNet with grouped convolutions (cardinality), improving accuracy over width and depth scaling.

entries.title: RetinaNet
entries.description: Focal loss — solves class imbalance in dense detection. Used in One-stage detection baseline.

entries.title: Recurrent Neural Network
entries.description: A class of neural networks where connections form a directed graph along a sequence, allowing it to exhibit temporal dynamic behavior.

entries.title: RoBERTa
entries.description: Robustly optimized BERT pre-training approach showing that BERT was significantly undertrained, achieving new GLUE state-of-the-art with better training recipes.

entries.title: RT-DETR
entries.description: Real-time end-to-end detection — efficient encoder + uncertainty-minimal queries. Used in Baidu, real-time DETR.

entries.title: RWKV
entries.description: Receptance Weighted Key Value — RNN architecture with transformer-level performance that scales linearly and can be formulated as either an RNN or transformer.

entries.title: S4
entries.description: Structured State Space Sequence model using the HiPPO matrix to efficiently model long-range dependencies with sub-quadratic complexity.

entries.title: SAC
entries.description: Maximum entropy RL — entropy bonus + twin critics — sample efficient + stable. Used in Robotic locomotion, sim-to-real.

entries.title: SAM
entries.description: Promptable segmentation — point, box, or text prompt → mask. Used in Meta's segment-anything tool.

entries.title: SAM 2
entries.description: Video object segmentation — streaming memory attention. Used in Meta, video editing tools.

entries.title: SASRec
entries.description: Self-attentive sequential recommendation — unidirectional transformer. Used in Sequential recommendation.

entries.title: Score SDE
entries.description: Continuous-time SDEs unifying score matching and diffusion. Used in Theoretical foundation.

entries.title: SDXL
entries.description: Larger UNet, dual CLIP text encoders, refinement stage — 1024px native. Used in Stability AI, production.

entries.title: SeamlessM4T
entries.description: Speech + text translation in 100+ languages — single multimodal model. Used in Meta speech translation.

entries.title: SegFormer
entries.description: Hierarchical transformer encoder + lightweight MLP decoder. Used in Efficient semantic segmentation.

entries.title: SegNet
entries.description: Encoder-decoder with max-pooling indices — efficient upsampling. Used in Embedded segmentation.

entries.title: SENet
entries.description: Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks that adaptively recalibrate channel-wise feature responses by explicitly modeling interdependencies between channels.

entries.title: Seq2Seq
entries.description: Encoder-decoder architecture mapping an input sequence to an output sequence of a different length.

entries.title: ShuffleNet
entries.description: Efficient mobile CNN using channel shuffle and pointwise group convolutions to reduce computation while maintaining accuracy.

entries.title: ShuffleNetV2
entries.description: Practical guidelines for efficient CNN design based on memory access cost analysis, leading to a faster and more accurate mobile architecture.

entries.title: SqueezeNet
entries.description: AlexNet-level accuracy with 50x fewer parameters using Fire modules with squeeze and expand layers, fitting in under 0.5 MB.

entries.title: SSD
entries.description: Multi-scale default boxes — single-shot, no RPN, various aspect ratios. Used in Mobile detection, real-time.

entries.title: Stable Diffusion
entries.description: Latent diffusion model that dramatically reduces the computational cost of high-resolution image generation.

entries.title: Stable Diffusion 3
entries.description: Multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) — separate text/image streams. Used in Stability AI production.

entries.title: StyleGAN
entries.description: Mapping network + AdaIN style injection — disentangled latent space. Used in Photorealistic face generation.

entries.title: StyleGAN2
entries.description: Weight demodulation — removes water droplet artifacts from StyleGAN. Used in Production portrait generation.

entries.title: StyleGAN3
entries.description: Alias-free GAN — translation equivariance via continuous signal theory. Used in Research-grade generation.

entries.title: SVD++
entries.description: Incorporates implicit feedback into MF. Used in Netflix, recommendation baselines.

entries.title: Swin Transformer
entries.description: A hierarchical Vision Transformer whose representation is computed with shifted windows.

entries.title: Swin Transformer
entries.description: Shifted window attention — hierarchical feature maps, O(N) complexity. Used in Object detection backbone (COCO SOTA).

entries.title: Swin v2
entries.description: 3B params, cosine attention, log-spaced CPB — scales to higher resolution. Used in Large-scale vision.

entries.title: T5
entries.description: Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer frames every NLP problem as a text-to-text task.

entries.title: TCN
entries.description: Temporal Convolutional Network using dilated causal convolutions with residual connections for sequence modeling, rivaling recurrent architectures.

entries.title: TD3
entries.description: Twin critics + delayed policy update + target smoothing — addresses DDPG overestimation. Used in Continuous control benchmark.

entries.title: TransE
entries.description: h + r ≈ t in embedding space — simple relational learning. Used in Knowledge graph embeddings.

entries.title: Transformer
entries.description: Attention-based architecture that replaced recurrence with parallel self-attention, powering all modern LLMs.

entries.title: Transformer-XL
entries.description: Transformer with segment-level recurrence and relative positional encodings enabling longer context than vanilla transformers without fixed-length segments.

entries.title: TRPO
entries.description: Trust region constraint — guaranteed monotonic policy improvement. Used in Robotic control research.

entries.title: Two-Tower Model
entries.description: Separate user tower + item tower — efficient retrieval via ANN. Used in YouTube recommendations, retrieval stage.

entries.title: U-Net
entries.description: Skip connections across encoder-decoder — precise localization. Used in Medical image segmentation (gold standard).

entries.title: U-Net++
entries.description: Nested dense skip connections — re-designs skip path. Used in Medical image benchmarks.

entries.title: U-Net
entries.description: Symmetric U-shaped architecture designed initially for biomedical image segmentation.

entries.title: Variational AutoEncoder
entries.description: Probabilistic autoencoder that learns a distribution over the latent space, enabling generation of new data.

entries.title: VGG16
entries.description: A very deep CNN using exclusively 3x3 convolutions to achieve high accuracy in image classification.

entries.title: VGG19
entries.description: An extension of VGG16 with 19 weight layers, demonstrating that depth is a critical component for good representations.

entries.title: VGGNet
entries.description: Very deep CNN from Oxford using only 3x3 convolutions stacked in increasing depth, showing that depth is a critical component of network accuracy.

entries.title: Vision Transformer (ViT)
entries.description: Images as sequences of 16×16 patches fed to a standard Transformer encoder — ended the CNN monopoly on computer vision.

entries.title: VQGAN
entries.description: Vector-quantized GAN — discrete codebook + perceptual loss + transformer. Used in Latent diffusion predecessor.

entries.title: WaveNet
entries.description: Deep generative model for raw audio waveforms using dilated causal convolutions to capture long-range temporal dependencies at sample level.

entries.title: WGAN
entries.description: Wasserstein distance as training objective — meaningful gradient everywhere. Used in Stable GAN training.

entries.title: WGAN-GP
entries.description: Gradient penalty instead of weight clipping — improved Wasserstein GAN. Used in Standard stable GAN training.

entries.title: Whisper
entries.description: Weakly supervised speech recognition — 680K hours, multilingual, multitask. Used in OpenAI, production transcription.

entries.title: Wide & Deep
entries.description: Joint wide (memorization) + deep (generalization) model. Used in Google Play App Store.

entries.title: Wide ResNet
entries.description: Study showing that wider (more filters) residual networks outperform deeper ones, trading depth for width to improve accuracy and reduce training time.

entries.title: Word2Vec
entries.description: Shallow neural network for learning dense word vector representations via Skip-gram or CBOW objectives, encoding semantic similarity as geometric proximity.

entries.title: Xception
entries.description: Extreme Inception replacing Inception modules with depthwise separable convolutions, hypothesizing complete separation of cross-channel and spatial correlations.

entries.title: XLM
entries.description: Cross-lingual Language Model pre-training enabling transfer across 15 languages using translation language modeling and shared BPE vocabulary.

entries.title: XLM-RoBERTa
entries.description: Massively multilingual RoBERTa pre-trained on 2.5TB of filtered CommonCrawl data in 100 languages, setting new cross-lingual benchmarks.

entries.title: XLNet
entries.description: Generalized autoregressive pre-training using permutation language modeling to capture bidirectional context without masking tokens.

entries.title: YOLO v1
entries.description: Single-pass detection — grid cells predict boxes + classes simultaneously. Used in Real-time detection.

entries.title: YOLO v2
entries.description: Anchor boxes + BatchNorm + Darknet-19 — 9000-class detection. Used in Real-time object detection.

entries.title: YOLO v3
entries.description: Multi-scale prediction — Darknet-53 backbone, class prediction sigmoid. Used in Industry real-time detection.

entries.title: YOLO v4
entries.description: CSPDarknet53, PANet, CIoU loss — optimal speed/accuracy. Used in Production detection.

entries.title: YOLO v5
entries.description: PyTorch rewrite, auto-anchor, extensive augmentation. Used in Most deployed YOLO version.

entries.title: YOLOv8
entries.description: Anchor-free, decoupled head, unified tasks (detect/seg/pose). Used in Ultralytics hub, edge deployment.

entries.title: ZFNet
entries.description: AlexNet refinement using deconvolution visualization to understand feature activations, winning ILSVRC 2013 by tuning filter sizes and strides.

entries.title: Attention Is All You Need Implementation
entries.description: Step-by-step PyTorch implementation of Attention Is All You Need

entries.title: BERT Implementation
entries.description: Step-by-step PyTorch implementation of BERT

entries.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
entries.description: Implement the core contrastive learning loop of CLIP to align image and text embeddings.

entries.title: GAN Implementation
entries.description: Step-by-step PyTorch implementation of GAN

entries.title: GPT Implementation
entries.description: Step-by-step PyTorch implementation of GPT

entries.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
entries.description: Implement the architectural improvements that define LLaMA, including RMSNorm, RoPE, and SwiGLU.

entries.title: ResNet Implementation
entries.description: Step-by-step PyTorch implementation of ResNet

entries.title: Stable Diffusion Implementation
entries.description: Step-by-step PyTorch implementation of Stable Diffusion

entries.title: Vision Transformer (ViT)
entries.description: Implement the Vision Transformer from scratch, including patch embeddings and the CLS token.

entries.title: Explain Attention to a Junior Engineer
entries.description: The most common modern ML interview question — explain self-attention clearly at three levels of depth.

entries.title: What Is Gradient Descent?
entries.description: Foundational interview question covering optimization intuition, learning rates, and SGD variants.

entries.title: Linear Algebra Foundations
entries.description: Vectors, matrices, and the operations every neural network is built from.

entries.title: Softmax Function
entries.description: Turning arbitrary scores into probability distributions — the heart of attention and classification.

entries.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Novel View Synthesis
entries.description: Real-time 3D scene representation via explicit Gaussian primitives. 100× faster rendering than NeRF. Transformed 3D reconstruction for VR/AR applications.

entries.title: A General Reinforcement Learning Algorithm that Masters Chess, Shogi, Go and Atari (Agent57)
entries.description: First RL agent to outperform human players on ALL 57 Atari games. Adaptive meta-controller balancing exploration. Showed RL can achieve broad generalization.

entries.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
entries.description: The default optimizer for deep learning. Adaptive learning rates per parameter + momentum = reliable convergence across architectures. Still the first choice 10 years later.

entries.title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models (ControlNet)
entries.description: Trainable copy of diffusion encoder + zero-convolution enables precise spatial control from edges, depth maps, poses, and sketches. Made controllable image generation practical.

entries.title: Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods (TD3)
entries.description: Identified and fixed overestimation bias in DDPG. Twin critics + delayed policy updates + target policy smoothing. Most reliable continuous control algorithm before SAC.

entries.title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
entries.description: First systematic benchmark for evaluating LLMs as agents across 8 distinct environments: OS (bash commands), DB (SQL), KG (SPARQL), digital card games, lateral thinking puzzles, house-holding, web shopping, and web browsing. Reveals massive gaps between proprietary and open models; GPT-4 significantly outperforms all open models.

entries.title: ALBERT: A Lite BERT for Self-supervised Learning
entries.description: 18× fewer parameters than BERT-Large with same accuracy via cross-layer parameter sharing and factorized embedding. Showed that model size and parameter count can be decoupled.

entries.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
entries.description: AlexNet â€” the GPU-trained CNN that won ImageNet 2012 by a 10-point margin and started the deep learning era.

entries.title: Align Before You Fuse: A Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation Model (BLIP)
entries.description: Introduced MED (Multimodal mixture of Encoder-Decoder) and CapFilt for noisy web data. Bootstrapping with captioner + filter improved training data quality. Defined the BLIP training paradigm.

entries.title: Alpa: Automating Inter- and Intra-Operator Parallelism for Distributed Deep Learning
entries.description: Manually choosing data / tensor / pipeline parallelism strategies is a combinatorial search problem. Alpa automates this: it performs inter-operator parallelism planning (pipeline stages) and intra-operator parallelism planning (tensor/data split within each stage) jointly using dynamic programming. Achieves near-expert parallelism configurations automatically.

entries.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale (ViT)
entries.description: Proved Transformers work for vision without convolutional inductive biases. Given enough data, pure attention beats CNNs. Unified the architectural language of vision and language.

entries.title: Attention Is All You Need
entries.description: Eliminated recurrence from sequence modeling. Enabled parallelizable training of language models. Directly produced BERT, GPT, T5, ViT, and every modern LLM.

entries.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes (VAE)
entries.description: Introduced principled probabilistic generative modeling. The ELBO objective and reparameterization trick enabled end-to-end training of generative models with latent variables.

entries.title: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
entries.description: Framework for LLMs to converse and collaborate as agents. Human proxies, automated code execution, flexible conversation patterns. Became the most-used multi-agent framework.

entries.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
entries.description: Introduced the additive attention mechanism, enabling models to search for relevant source positions dynamically during translation.

entries.title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training
entries.description: Encoder-decoder trained with denoising (text infilling, sentence permutation). Best model for generation tasks at release — summarization, translation, QA. Combines BERT's understanding with GPT's generation.

entries.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
entries.description: Batch Normalization â€” normalized layer inputs per mini-batch, solving internal covariate shift and enabling training of very deep networks at high learning rates.

entries.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training
entries.description: Enabled training of much deeper networks at higher learning rates. Reduced sensitivity to initialization. For several years the default normalization in every CNN.

entries.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
entries.description: BERT — introduced masked language modeling and next sentence prediction for bidirectional pre-training, redefining NLP transfer learning.

entries.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
entries.description: Pre-training on masked language modeling then fine-tuning set new SOTA on 11 NLP benchmarks simultaneously. Defined the "pre-train, fine-tune" paradigm that dominates NLP.

entries.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and LLMs
entries.description: Q-Former bridges frozen image encoder and frozen LLM — only Q-Former trained. 54× fewer trainable parameters than Flamingo. State-of-art zero-shot VQA efficiently.

entries.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
entries.description: Adding "Let's think step by step" dramatically improves LLM reasoning on math, logic, and complex tasks. Emergent only at sufficient scale. Sparked the entire prompting engineering field.

entries.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
entries.description: Chinchilla — proved that existing LLMs were undertrained; optimal scaling requires equal scaling of parameters and data.

entries.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
entries.description: CLIP — trained a vision model on 400M image-text pairs via contrastive learning, enabling zero-shot image classification and text-image alignment.

entries.title: CoCa: Contrastive Captioners are Image-Text Foundation Models
entries.description: Combined contrastive loss (like CLIP) and captioning loss (like generative models) in a single training. Best of both worlds — strong retrieval AND strong generation from one model.

entries.title: CogAgent: A Visual Language Model for GUI Agents
entries.description: Demonstrates a VLM trained specifically to interact with computer GUIs — clicking, typing, navigating — by predicting actions from screenshots. CogAgent introduces a high-resolution image encoder (1120×1120) for reading fine-grained UI text, combined with a low-resolution context encoder. Achieves SOTA on GUI-grounding and web agent benchmarks.

entries.title: CogVLM: Visual Expert for Pretrained Language Models
entries.description: Most multimodal LLMs inject visual features via cross-attention or prefix tokens, but this forces the language model to use the same weights for both text and vision — a poor inductive bias. CogVLM adds a separate "visual expert" — trainable Q, K, V projections in each transformer layer for visual tokens — while freezing the LLM. Achieves state-of-the-art on 17 benchmarks.

entries.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction
entries.description: Late interaction — compress query and document to token-level embeddings, compute similarity at retrieval time. Better accuracy than bi-encoders, faster than cross-encoders. Core IR innovation.

entries.title: ColBERT v2: Effective and Efficient Retrieval via Lightweight Late Interaction
entries.description: Centroid-based compression + residual codes reduce ColBERT storage 6–10×. State-of-art retrieval quality with manageable index sizes. Standard high-accuracy retrieval baseline.

entries.title: Consistency Models
entries.description: Single-step generation via self-consistency — any point on the ODE trajectory maps to the same origin. 100× faster than DDPM with competitive quality. Enabled real-time image generation.

entries.title: Consistency Models
entries.description: Standard diffusion models require 20–1000 denoising steps for high-quality generation. Consistency models learn to map any point on the diffusion trajectory directly to the clean data in one step, enabling single-step generation at competitive quality. Consistency distillation trains from a pretrained diffusion model; consistency training learns from scratch.

entries.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
entries.description: AI can critique and revise its own outputs using a constitution. Scalable oversight without human raters at every step. RLAIF as alternative to RLHF. Claude's alignment method.

entries.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
entries.description: CAI introduces a two-phase training process: (1) critique-revision — the model critiques its own harmful outputs according to a "constitution" of principles and revises them; (2) RL from AI Feedback (RLAIF) — a feedback model trained on these critiques generates preference labels, replacing human annotators for harmlessness. This showed AI can train itself to be safer.

entries.title: Contextual Retrieval (Anthropic)
entries.description: Identifies that naive chunking strips context from chunks — a sentence about "Q3 revenue declined" has no meaning without knowing what company and what document it came from. Contextual Retrieval prepends a brief contextual header to each chunk using Claude before embedding. Reduces retrieval failure rate by 49% combined with BM25 hybrid search.

entries.title: ControlNet: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
entries.description: Controlling diffusion model outputs beyond text — by pose, depth map, edge map, segmentation — required fine-tuning the entire model. ControlNet freezes the original model and trains a trainable copy of the encoder with "zero convolution" layers, so control signals can be injected without disrupting the pretrained weights. One GPU, 50 hours of training.

entries.title: Corrective RAG (CRAG): Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
entries.description: CRAG adds a retrieval evaluator that scores the relevance of retrieved documents. If documents are irrelevant, CRAG triggers web search as a fallback. If documents are ambiguous, it decomposes them into fine-grained chunks and filters knowledge strips. Prevents generation hallucinations from bad retrievals.

entries.title: cuDNN: Efficient Primitives for Deep Learning
entries.description: cuDNN provides GPU-optimized implementations of convolutions, matrix multiplications, activation functions, normalization layers, and RNNs. It exposes an API that all major frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, MXNet) call internally. The FFT-based and Winograd convolution algorithms in cuDNN enabled the first practical deep CNN training on GPUs.

entries.title: DALL·E 2: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents
entries.description: DALL·E 2 bridges the CLIP embedding space and a diffusion decoder. A prior model maps text CLIP embeddings to image CLIP embeddings, then a diffusion decoder generates the image. This separation enables sophisticated image editing (outpainting, inpainting, image variations) by manipulating CLIP embeddings rather than pixels.

entries.title: DeBERTa: Decoding-enhanced BERT with Disentangled Attention
entries.description: Disentangled attention (position and content separate) + enhanced mask decoder. Surpassed human performance on SuperGLUE with DeBERTa-xxlarge. Best performing BERT-style model.

entries.title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
entries.description: Offline RL as conditional sequence modeling. Return-conditioned autoregressive policy using GPT. No Bellman equations, no bootstrapping — just sequence modeling. Bridged RL and LLMs.

entries.title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
entries.description: Reframes RL as a sequence modeling problem: given past states, actions, and return-to-go (desired cumulative reward), predict the next action. Uses a GPT-2 style transformer. At test time, condition on a high desired return to get high-reward behavior. No Bellman equations, no Q-learning — just supervised learning on trajectories.

entries.title: Deep contextualized word representations (ELMo)
entries.description: First contextual word embeddings — same word has different representations depending on context. Showed that multiple layers of a language model capture different linguistic properties.

entries.title: Deep Double Descent
entries.description: Overturned classical statistical learning theory. Showed that overparameterized models (like modern neural networks) do NOT overfit — they interpolate and generalize. Explains why large models work.

entries.title: Deep Learning (Nature Review)
entries.description: The canonical review of deep learning by its three founding fathers. Explains the full stack — representations, convolutional nets, recurrent nets, optimization — in one paper.

entries.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
entries.description: The ResNet paper — skip connections that made 100+ layer networks trainable and won ImageNet 2015.

entries.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
entries.description: Solved the vanishing gradient problem for very deep networks. Enabled training of 100–1000 layer networks. Skip connections became the standard building block of modern deep learning.

entries.title: DeepSpeed: System Optimizations Enable Training Deep Learning Models with Over 100 Billion Parameters
entries.description: ZeRO optimizer + mixed precision + gradient checkpointing in one system. Enabled training of models that couldn't fit in memory otherwise. Microsoft's production training framework.

entries.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM)
entries.description: Non-Markovian inference process enables 10–50× faster sampling than DDPM with same quality. Deterministic sampling → reproducible generation, interpolation in latent space.

entries.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM)
entries.description: DDPM requires thousands of denoising steps to generate a sample. DDIM reformulates the reverse process as a non-Markovian deterministic process, enabling generation in 10–50 steps without retraining. Crucially, DDIM enables meaningful latent interpolation: walking the latent trajectory produces smooth image interpolations.

entries.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM)
entries.description: Showed that diffusion models could generate high-quality images by gradually denoising Gaussian noise. Simpler training than GANs, better mode coverage. Foundation of the entire diffusion model ecosystem.

entries.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering (DPR)
entries.description: Showed that dense bi-encoder retrieval with in-batch negative training outperforms TF-IDF/BM25 on open-domain QA. Defined the bi-encoder training recipe used in all dense retrievers.

entries.title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks (DenseNet)
entries.description: Every layer connects to all subsequent layers — maximum feature reuse, minimal parameters. Demonstrated that dense connectivity encourages feature reuse and strengthens gradient flow.

entries.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
entries.description: ViT features trained at scale on curated data match or exceed specialized supervised models on dense prediction tasks. Universal visual feature extractor without fine-tuning.

entries.title: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
entries.description: Eliminated the RL loop from RLHF. DPO optimizes preferences directly from a supervised loss — simpler, more stable, cheaper than PPO. Became the standard alignment technique for open-source models.

entries.title: Distributed Representations of Words (Word2Vec)
entries.description: Showed that words could be represented as dense vectors capturing semantic relationships. "King - Man + Woman = Queen." Launched the embedding paradigm.

entries.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
entries.description: Introduced DPO, a mathematically formulation that optimizes language models based on preference pairs directly, bypassing reward model training and PPO reinforcement learning.

entries.title: DPR: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
entries.description: Open-domain QA traditionally used BM25 sparse retrieval, which requires exact keyword match. DPR trains two BERT encoders — one for questions, one for passages — with in-batch negatives, enabling semantic retrieval. Shows that dense vectors outperform BM25 on open-domain QA while being indexable with FAISS.

entries.title: Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination (Dreamer)
entries.description: World model in latent space. Learn actor-critic entirely in imagination — no real environment rollouts during policy optimization. 26× more sample-efficient than model-free on visual control.

entries.title: DreamBooth: Fine Tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models for Subject-Driven Generation
entries.description: 3–5 images of a subject → fine-tuned model that generates the subject in any context. Prior preservation loss prevents overfitting. Defined personalized image generation.

entries.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
entries.description: The canonical regularization technique for neural networks. Simple to implement, effective across architectures. Reframed regularization as approximate model ensembling.

entries.title: Efficient and Robust Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Using HNSW
entries.description: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) achieves logarithmic search with high recall. The dominant ANN algorithm in production vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, and Qdrant all use HNSW.

entries.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention (vLLM)
entries.description: KV cache management via virtual memory pages eliminates memory fragmentation. 24× higher throughput than HuggingFace Transformers. Defined production LLM serving.

entries.title: Efficient Nearest Neighbor Language Models (FAISS)
entries.description: Library for efficient similarity search over billions of vectors. IVF, HNSW, Product Quantization implementations at industrial scale. The infrastructure layer of all vector retrieval.

entries.title: Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference
entries.description: Systematic analysis of how to partition large transformer inference across TPU/GPU pods. Introduces the arithmetic intensity framework for choosing between model parallelism strategies. Shows when tensor parallelism vs. pipeline parallelism vs. batch splitting is optimal as a function of model size, batch size, and hardware topology.

entries.title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for CNNs
entries.description: Showed that jointly scaling width, depth, and resolution (compound scaling) yields better performance than scaling any dimension alone. Set ImageNet accuracy records while being smaller than competitors.

entries.title: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators
entries.description: Replaced token detection vs. masked language modeling — every token contributes to training signal vs. 15% in BERT. Same accuracy at 1/4 the compute. More sample-efficient pre-training.

entries.title: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators Rather than Generators
entries.description: BERT masks ~15% of tokens and predicts only them — 85% of tokens contribute nothing to the loss. ELECTRA trains a discriminator to detect whether each token was replaced by a generator, learning from every token simultaneously. Achieves BERT performance with 4× less compute; ELECTRA-Small outperforms GPT on GLUE.

entries.title: Emerging Abilities of Large Language Models
entries.description: Documented capabilities that appear abruptly at scale thresholds: arithmetic, chain-of-thought, analogical reasoning. Showed there are qualitative phase transitions in LLM capability.

entries.title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers (DINO)
entries.description: Self-distillation with no labels produces attention maps that segment objects without supervision. DINO features are among the most transferable in computer vision.

entries.title: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers (DETR)
entries.description: Eliminated anchor boxes, NMS, and hand-designed components. First end-to-end object detector. Bipartite matching loss. Started the transformer-in-vision movement.

entries.title: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents (CodeAct)
entries.description: Demonstrates that having agents express actions as executable Python code (rather than JSON function calls) is superior: code is composable, can loop and branch, can define reusable functions, and produces better results on agent benchmarks. CodeAct + CodeActInstruct fine-tuning yields the best open-source agent.

entries.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with T5
entries.description: Unified all NLP tasks as text-to-text. Systematic ablation over architecture, pre-training objectives, datasets. Most thorough study of transfer learning. T5 architecture underlies Flan-T5, coding models.

entries.title: Faster R-CNN: Towards Real-Time Object Detection with Region Proposal Networks
entries.description: Unified region proposal and detection in one network. The definitive two-stage detector. Region Proposal Network + RoI Pooling became the standard pipeline for accurate detection.

entries.title: Feature Pyramid Networks for Object Detection
entries.description: Solved multi-scale object detection by building a feature pyramid with lateral connections. Small objects detected from high-resolution low-level features; large objects from low-resolution high-level features.

entries.title: Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners (FLAN)
entries.description: Fine-tuning on diverse instruction templates enables strong zero-shot generalization. More diverse tasks → better generalization. Started the instruction tuning paradigm.

entries.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
entries.description: First few-shot multimodal model. Perceiver resampler + cross-attention into frozen LLM. Few-shot visual QA, captioning, classification without fine-tuning. Defined vision-language pre-training at scale.

entries.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
entries.description: Flamingo interleaves visual and text tokens in a pretrained frozen language model using Perceiver Resampler (to compress variable-resolution images into fixed-size embeddings) and cross-attention layers inserted between transformer blocks. Enables few-shot visual QA from just a few examples — no gradient updates at test time. First large-scale few-shot multimodal model.

entries.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
entries.description: Introduced an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling and softmax recomputation to avoid materializing the quadratic attention matrix in slow GPU memory.

entries.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
entries.description: Revised the tiling strategy from FlashAttention-1, reducing non-matmul FLOPs and improving thread block utilization. Achieves 50–73% of theoretical A100 MFU for attention — 2× faster than FlashAttention-1. Non-causal and multi-head attention coverage added.

entries.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
entries.description: Rewrote attention as an IO-aware algorithm — tiles the attention computation to avoid materializing the full n×n matrix. 2–4× speedup, O(n) memory. Made long-context training practical.

entries.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
entries.description: Standard attention computes a full N×N attention matrix in HBM (slow GPU memory), requiring O(N²) memory. FlashAttention computes attention in tiled blocks entirely in SRAM (fast on-chip memory), reducing memory to O(N) and achieving 2–4× speedup. This made training on long sequences practical and is now standard in every major LLM.

entries.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
entries.description: Straight-line paths from noise to data vs. curved diffusion paths. Fewer NFE (function evaluations) needed. Conceptually simpler than score-based models. Basis for Stable Diffusion 3 and Flux.

entries.title: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection (RetinaNet)
entries.description: Solved class imbalance in single-stage detectors with Focal Loss — down-weights easy negatives. Made single-stage detectors competitive with two-stage at accuracy.

entries.title: Fusion-in-Decoder (FiD): Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering
entries.description: RAG-style models concatenate all retrieved passages and feed them together to the generator — hitting context window limits quickly. FiD encodes each passage independently with the encoder and fuses them in the decoder via cross-attention. This allows 100 passages to be processed at the cost of encoding, not the quadratic cost of concatenation.

entries.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
entries.description: The GAN paper — introduced adversarial training between a generator and discriminator to synthesize realistic data.

entries.title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
entries.description: First natively multimodal model at frontier scale — trained jointly on text, image, audio, video. Gemini Ultra surpassed GPT-4 on MMLU. Defined Google's multimodal AI direction.

entries.title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
entries.description: Gemini Ultra surpasses GPT-4 on 30 of 32 benchmarks and is the first model to exceed human expert performance on MMLU. Designed as natively multimodal from pretraining (not retrofitted vision). Accepts text, images, audio, and video interleaved. Gemini 1.5 Pro extended context to 1M tokens using ring attention and linear transformers.

entries.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
entries.description: Introduced adversarial training — one of the most generative ideas in ML. Directly spawned the entire generative AI field: image synthesis, data augmentation, domain adaptation.

entries.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
entries.description: Demonstrated LLM agents with persistent memory, reflection, and planning can simulate believable human behavior. 25 agents in a Sims-like world with emergent social behaviors.

entries.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
entries.description: Creates 25 AI agents in a Sims-like virtual town, each with memories, plans, and social relationships. Introduces a memory architecture with recency/importance/relevance retrieval, reflection (periodically synthesize memories into higher-level insights), and planning (daily schedules derived from character background). Agents exhibit emergent social behavior.

entries.title: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation
entries.description: Combined global matrix factorization with local context windows. Demonstrated that word vectors encode syntactic and semantic relationships. More efficient than Word2Vec on large corpora.

entries.title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs
entries.description: Fine-tuned LLaMA on 1,645 APIs across HuggingFace, TorchHub, TensorFlow Hub. Reduced hallucination in API calls via retrieval-aware training. Practical tool-use at scale.

entries.title: GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism
entries.description: GPipe splits a model into sequential micro-stages across devices and streams micro-batches through the pipeline, keeping all devices active simultaneously. Enables training models that don't fit on a single accelerator. The re-materialization strategy (recompute activations in backward pass) reduces memory by factor proportional to pipeline depth.

entries.title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
entries.description: GPT-1 â€” introduced the decoder-only Transformer with unsupervised pre-training + supervised fine-tuning paradigm for NLP.

entries.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
entries.description: GPT-2 â€” scaled language modeling to 1.5B parameters on WebText, demonstrating zero-shot task transfer and sparking debates about AI safety.

entries.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
entries.description: GPT-3 — 175B parameters demonstrate in-context learning: tasks specified by prompt, no gradient updates.

entries.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
entries.description: Multimodal, dramatically more capable than GPT-3.5. First frontier model technical report describing evaluation methodology, alignment techniques, and capability/safety evaluations at scale.

entries.title: GPT-4V: System Card
entries.description: First commercially deployed frontier multimodal model. GPT-4V accepts images as input alongside text and handles visual QA, chart understanding, diagram interpretation, OCR, coding from screenshots, and medical image analysis. Demonstrated that capable vision understanding emerges at scale. Set the benchmark that all subsequent VLMs target.

entries.title: Hierarchical Text-Conditional Image Generation with CLIP Latents (DALL-E 2)
entries.description: CLIP image embeddings as prior between text and image. Demonstrated semantic image editing, interpolation, and text-image combination. Showed diffusion + CLIP = high-fidelity controllable generation.

entries.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models (Stable Diffusion)
entries.description: Moved diffusion to latent space — 4–8× smaller, enabling high-resolution generation on consumer GPUs. CLIP conditioning for text-to-image. Open-sourced — spawned entire creative AI ecosystem.

entries.title: Hindsight Experience Replay (HER)
entries.description: Solved sparse reward problem by relabeling failed trajectories with achieved goals. Enables learning goal-conditioned policies even when every episode fails. Critical for robotics.

entries.title: Human-Level Control through Deep Reinforcement Learning (Rainbow)
entries.description: Systematic combination of 6 DQN improvements (double, dueling, prioritized replay, n-step, distributional, noisy). Each improvement synergizes. Defined modern value-based RL.

entries.title: HyDE: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
entries.description: Zero-shot dense retrieval suffers because query embeddings are short and vague while document embeddings are dense with information. HyDE generates a hypothetical document from the query using an LLM, embeds that hypothetical document, and retrieves real documents similar to the hypothesis. Outperforms DPR zero-shot without any training.

entries.title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space to Bind Them All
entries.description: Single embedding space for 6 modalities — images, text, audio, depth, thermal, IMU. Audio-image and text-audio alignment without paired data, via binding through images. Any-to-any retrieval.

entries.title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space to Bind Them All
entries.description: Aligns six modalities — images, text, audio, depth, thermal, IMU data — in a shared embedding space using only image-paired data for each modality. Audio-text alignment is never trained directly, yet emerges from both modalities being aligned to images. Enables zero-shot cross-modal retrieval (find images from audio, find audio from text) without paired training data.

entries.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (AlexNet)
entries.description: The paper that started the modern deep learning era. Won ImageNet by a margin that made the field pivot overnight. Demonstrated that GPUs + large data + deep CNNs were qualitatively better than hand-engineered features.

entries.title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training (GPT-1)
entries.description: Established the pretrain-then-fine-tune recipe for decoder-only Transformers and showed that one generative language model could transfer to many supervised NLP tasks.

entries.title: Inception v1 (GoogLeNet)
entries.description: Inception module: parallel branches with different receptive fields. Demonstrated that networks could be wider (not just deeper) while reducing parameters. 1×1 convolutions for channel mixing.

entries.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
entries.description: Introduced the Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipeline used to align language models with user intent.

entries.title: Internet-Augmented Language Models through Few-Shot Prompting (FreshLLMs/FLARE)
entries.description: Active retrieval — predict next sentence, retrieve if low confidence. Interleaves retrieval with generation rather than retrieve-once. More accurate for long-form generation.

entries.title: JAX: Composable Transformations of NumPy Programs
entries.description: JAX treats neural network computation as pure functional transformations — `grad`, `jit`, `vmap`, `pmap` compose freely. This enables writing research code that compiles to XLA and runs identically on CPU/GPU/TPU. It is Google's primary research framework for Gemini, Gemma, and AlphaFold.

entries.title: JAX: Composable Transformations of Python+NumPy Programs
entries.description: A guided reading of JAX: Composable Transformations of Python+NumPy Programs.

entries.title: Knowledge Distillation
entries.description: Showed that a small network can learn from a large network's soft outputs, achieving near-large-model accuracy. Core technique for model compression and the basis for DistilBERT, TinyBERT.

entries.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
entries.description: 175B parameters demonstrated emergent capabilities — arithmetic, translation, coding — without fine-tuning. In-context learning changed how we think about NLP. Started the LLM era.

entries.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (GPT-2)
entries.description: Demonstrated that scaling a language model on broad web text produces useful zero-shot behavior without task-specific supervised training.

entries.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
entries.description: LDM — performed diffusion in the compressed latent space of a VAE, enabling high-resolution image synthesis on consumer hardware; foundation of Stable Diffusion.

entries.title: LATS: Language Agent Tree Search
entries.description: Combines LLMs with Monte Carlo Tree Search. At each node, the agent takes an action (tool call, reasoning step), scores the state with an LLM-based value function, and backtracks when stuck. Outperforms ReAct, Reflexion, and chain-of-thought on HumanEval, WebShop, and HotpotQA. First principled application of MCTS to language agents.

entries.title: Layer Normalization
entries.description: Batch Normalization's successor for sequence models and Transformers. Normalizes over the feature dimension (not batch) — works with batch size 1. Required for Transformers to train stably.

entries.title: Learning Representations by Back-Propagating Errors
entries.description: Invented the algorithm that trains virtually every neural network ever built. Without backpropagation, deep learning as a field does not exist.

entries.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models from Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
entries.description: Image-text contrastive pre-training on 400M web pairs. Zero-shot image classification. CLIP representations are the most transferable in vision. Foundation for DALL-E 2, LLaVA, and most multimodal models.

entries.title: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain QA (FiD)
entries.description: Fuse-in-Decoder: encode top-k retrieved passages independently with BERT, fuse in T5 decoder. Simple but dramatically outperforms single-passage RAG. Most effective RAG architecture at the time.

entries.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
entries.description: Integrates knowledge graph construction with RAG. Extracts entities and relationships from documents, builds a local-global knowledge graph, and retrieves at multiple granularities: entity-level, community-level (clusters), and global summaries. Dramatically improves RAG over large corpora where relationships between entities matter.

entries.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
entries.description: LLaMA — Meta's open-weights LLM trained far beyond compute-optimal limits to provide maximum inference efficiency.

entries.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
entries.description: First openly licensed model family for commercial use. RLHF alignment details publicly disclosed. GQA for efficiency. Became the dominant open-source foundation model.

entries.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
entries.description: First open-weights Chinchilla-optimal model family. LLaMA-13B outperforms GPT-3 (175B) on most benchmarks. Triggered the open-source LLM ecosystem explosion.

entries.title: LLaVA: Visual Instruction Tuning
entries.description: LLaVA connects a CLIP vision encoder to Llama using a simple linear projection, then fine-tunes on GPT-4-generated visual instruction following data (image + text → instruction → response triples). Despite architectural simplicity, achieves 85.1% relative performance to GPT-4V on visual instruction following. Launched the open-source VLM research wave.

entries.title: Long Short-Term Memory
entries.description: Solved the vanishing gradient problem for recurrent networks. Enabled learning of long-range dependencies in sequences. Dominated NLP for 20 years until Transformers.

entries.title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
entries.description: Extended BERT to documents 4096+ tokens via sliding window attention + global attention. Made Transformer-based NLP practical for long documents like legal contracts and scientific papers.

entries.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
entries.description: Introduced Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) using low-rank decomposition matrices to update model weights without added inference latency.

entries.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
entries.description: Fine-tune 175B GPT-3 with only 0.01% of parameters trainable. Low-rank decomposition of weight updates — equal quality to full fine-tuning at 10,000× lower memory cost.

entries.title: Mask R-CNN
entries.description: Extended Faster R-CNN to instance segmentation by adding a mask head. RoIAlign fixed quantization artifacts. Defined the two-stage instance segmentation paradigm.

entries.title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners (MAE)
entries.description: Showed that masking 75% of image patches and reconstructing them produces powerful ViT representations. 3× faster training than contrastive methods. Simple yet effective self-supervised learning.

entries.title: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model (MuZero)
entries.description: Learns a model of the environment's dynamics without access to game rules. MuZero combines model learning + MCTS. Surpasses AlphaZero while working in unknown environments.

entries.title: Mastering Chess and Shogi by Self-Play with AlphaZero
entries.description: Single algorithm mastered Chess, Shogi, and Go from scratch using only self-play — no human data. Tabula rasa learning via self-play is sufficient for superhuman performance. Generalized AlphaGo.

entries.title: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search (AlphaGo)
entries.description: Beat world champion Go player. First superhuman performance in a game considered too complex for AI. Policy network + value network + MCTS = the AlphaGo paradigm.

entries.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using GPU Model Parallelism
entries.description: Intra-layer model parallelism for Transformers — split attention heads and FFN columns across GPUs. Enables training models that don't fit on a single node.

entries.title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for a Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
entries.description: Multi-agent system where LLMs take roles (PM, architect, engineer, QA). Produces a complete software project from a one-line requirement. Defined structured multi-agent collaboration.

entries.title: Mistral 7B
